description: OPTIONAL public scorecard: publish what a site's own test gate checked, as a dated section on one page. `npm run scorecard` runs the whole suite and writes scorecard.json (checks passed per area, pages, date, tested version); a component renders it and tells the reader when the site was edited after the run. The owner can add the four Lighthouse scores of a PageSpeed run, with a re-run link. A red run writes nothing, so a card never shows a failed run as passed. Never runs unasked: publishing test results is the owner's choice. Ships an opt-in tests/scorecard.spec.ts. Trigger phrases: "publish our test results", "public scorecard", "quality report", "show the Lighthouse scores on the site", "proof the site is tested", "update the scorecard". Not a performance audit (website-qa) and not an SEO report (search-console-insights).
